# Building pages: which part for which need

The table of Signal parts. `AGENTS.md` ("Building pages") points here; `llms-full.txt` carries a copy. The rows are generated from `docs/tables/agents/` by `scripts/doc-tables.mjs`: add or edit an entry file there, then run `pnpm build:docs`.

<!-- doc-table:agents (generated from docs/tables/agents/ by scripts/doc-tables.mjs: add or edit a file there, then run pnpm build:docs; do not edit these rows) -->
| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Reading page | `<main class="sd-page">` (720px column) or `sd-page sd-page-wide` |
| App with navigation | Signal App Shell: `sd-shell` > `sd-rail`, `sd-sidebar`, `sd-shell-main` (`sd-shell-header` or `sd-shell-bar`, `sd-shell-content`, optional `sd-shell-dock`), `sd-shell-aside`, `sd-statusbar sd-shell-status`. Copy the whole frame from [`showcase/chat.html`](https://github.com/Medalink/signal-design/blob/main/showcase/chat.html) in the repo (the package does not ship `showcase/`); README "Signal App Shell" lists its parts |
| A rail of places (groups, servers) | `sd-rail-tile` (picture, initials or icon) in a 72px rail (`--shell-rail: 4.5rem`); `aria-current`, `data-unread`, `data-pending`, corner `sd-badge-count` |
| Resizable sidebar | `sd-sidebar-resize` (`role="separator"`, `aria-valuemin`/`max`/`now`) last in `sd-sidebar`; `data-sd-shell="resize"` for the JS, or drive `--shell-sidebar` and `aria-valuenow` from your framework |
| Desktop window chrome | `sd-titlebar` with `sd-window-controls` (`data-sd-window`) |
| Buttons | `sd-btn` + `sd-btn-primary` (one per view) / `sd-btn-ghost` / `sd-btn-link`, sizes `-sm` `-lg` `-icon` `-block` |
| Icons | `sd-icon-text` > `sd-icon` + text; icons are sized to the text's cap height (`1.5cap`) and scale with it; the set of line icons is `icon(name)` from `signal-design/js/icons` (React `<Icon name>`), never a hand-copied path or another icon library |
| Forms | `sd-field` > `sd-field-label` + control + `sd-field-hint`; inputs are styled unclassed |
| Choices | `sd-seg` (segmented; `sd-seg-wrap` in a narrow container), `sd-options` > `sd-option` (cards with a description or preview), `role="switch"` checkbox, `sd-combobox`, `sd-tags`, `sd-number` |
| Overlays | `<dialog class="sd-dialog">` + `data-sd-open`; `popover` + `.sd-popover`; `data-sd-tip`; `toast()` |
| Lists and rows | `sd-item`, `sd-item-row` (a box around an `sd-item` link and an `sd-item-actions` cell with a trailing button such as Mark read or Remove; hover, focus and `aria-current` cover both), `sd-row`, `sd-table`, `sd-kv` (`sd-kv-plain` for sentence-case, truncating keys) |
| Settings groups | `sd-panel` (560px), `sd-panel-wide` (1024px), `sd-panel-fluid` (no cap) |
| Profile card | `sd-profile` (a person's card in an `sd-hovercard` or `sd-dialog-body`, no frame of its own: `-head` with `sd-avatar-xl`, `-name` in `--who`, `-status`; `-section` + `-label` over `-about` or `-groups`; `-actions` for Message and Call) |
| Status | `sd-badge`, `sd-status`, `sd-dot`, `sd-count`, `sd-progress` (`data-state="indeterminate"` when the amount is unknown), `sd-checks`, `sd-level` (live level from `--level`, 0–1) |
| Group welcome | `sd-welcome` (+ `-head`, `-name`, `-count`, `-rules`, `-labels`): a frameless block for the conversation area or an `sd-dialog-body`: `sd-rail-tile` tile, name and mono member count, caps `sd-label` over numbered rules, caps label over `sd-chip` toggles (`aria-pressed`, check `svg` shows when pressed, success tone), one `sd-btn-primary sd-btn-block` |
| Group emoji | A group's image emoji in `sd-emoji-picker`: a `data-group` category button (initials or an `img`), `img` buttons in `sd-emoji-grid` (`aria-current="true"` for the one the footer names), a `button[data-add]` slot, a footer of image and `:name:`; in text, `img.sd-emoji` (1.25em) with `alt=":name:"` |
| People | `sd-avatar` (`-sm` `-md` `-lg` `-xl`, or `--sd-avatar-size`) with `data-status`; on your own panel set `--sd-ring` to its background so the presence ring matches, `sd-avatar-grid` (a group chat: four `sd-avatar` two by two in one square, `role="img"` + `aria-label`; React `AvatarGrid`) |
| Chat and feeds | `sd-message` (time column, inline `sd-message-author` and an `sd-badge` after it for Agent; `--who` name color, `--edge` role color, `data-grouped`, `data-own`, `data-reply` + `sd-message-ref`, `data-editing`, `data-selected`), `sd-message-actions`, `sd-message-menu`, `sd-emoji-picker`, `sd-feed-day`, `sd-event`, `sd-feed-jump`, `sd-composer` (`-add`, `-reply`, `-status`, `-mic`; `data-recording` swaps the row for `-discard` and `-rec` with a pending dot, time and level wave; `sd-add-menu`) in an `sd-shell-dock` (`data-flush`), `data-sd-follow` on the feed (stays at the newest row, runs the jump bar), `data-joined` on `sd-shell-main` (bar, feed and composer as one surface), `sd-reactions`, `sd-roster`, `sd-banner`, `sd-file` (`-preview`: a text file's first 7 lines), `sd-link-card` (`-hero`, `-media` for an image-only card, `-compact`, `-type`, `-actions`, `-dismiss`, `-thumb-label`, `-thumb-action`, `data-blocked`, `aria-busy`; a `<div role="link">` hovers like a link), `sd-poll` (a decision: `-head`, `data-tone` while it waits, `data-chosen`, `-voters`), `button.sd-shot` (an image attachment: `-hint` icon on hover, `aria-busy` + `-status`, `data-failed` + `-note`), `sd-spoiler` (inline text behind a solid block: `role="button"` with `aria-expanded`, one inner `span`, `data-sd-spoiler`; React `Spoiler`), `sd-thread-chip` (under a root message: avatars, "N replies", last reply time; a button, `aria-expanded` while its thread is open, the root row takes `aria-current`; React `ThreadChip`), `sd-thread` (thread panel for `sd-shell-aside`: `-head`, `-title`, `-body`, `-root`, `-replies`, `-foot`; replies are `sd-message` with `data-compact`), `sd-catchup` (the "While you were away" card above the first unread row: `-head`, `-title`, `-stat`, `-list` with `-mark`, `-text`, `-count`, `-actions`; `sd-marker data-tone="pending"` under it is the new-messages line), `sd-activity` (an inbox: `sd-tabs` over `sd-tabpanel`s of `sd-item` rows with an `sd-item-mark` box, `<b class="sd-message-author">` + action, `sd-item-sub`, a mono `sd-item-end` time; `data-unread` puts a pending-tone square on the left edge), `sd-suggest-command` (a slash-command option in `sd-suggest`: mono command, faint `sd-menu-hint` arguments; `data-sd-trigger-start="/"` on the textarea, `data-trigger="/"` on the option), silent mark (an icon-only `bell-off` `<span role="img" aria-label="Sent silently">` in `sd-message-meta`) and send menu (`data-sd-contextmenu="id"` on `sd-composer-send` opening an `sd-message-menu`; no class of its own), `sd-voice` (a voice note in a message: `-play`, `-wave` as a slider of `<i>` bars with `--h` and `--at`, `--progress` to light them, `-time`, `-speed`; `data-playing`; the app owns the audio; React `VoiceNote`), `sd-event-card` (an event in a message: `-head`, `-title`, `-line`, `-who` with `sd-avatar-stack` and `-count`, `-rsvp` buttons with `aria-pressed` for the viewer's answer in success, `-add`; React `EventCard`), `sd-cw` (media behind a solid cover: `-media` holding an `sd-shot` or `sd-file`, `-cover` with an `sd-badge` chip and `button.sd-cw-toggle` whose `aria-expanded` is the state, `-show`/`-hide` labels, `data-sd-cw`; React `ContentWarning`), `sd-tasklist` (a shared checklist in a message: `-head`, `-label`, `-count`, `-title`, `-items` of `li` > `label` > checkbox + `span`, then `b` for who ticked it in `--who`, `-add`; the bar is `sd-progress` + `data-tone="success"`; React `TaskList`), `sd-ack` (the "Got it" row under an announce: primary `sd-btn`, `sd-cells sd-ack-cells` with `i[data-on]` per member who answered, `-count` as n/m in mono, `-waiting` with `b` names in `--who` for the announcer only; once answered the button is `data-tone="success"` + `disabled`; the announcer gets no button; React `AckBar`, `showAction={false}` for the announcer) |
| Data | `sd-stat`, `sd-stat-box`, `createChart(canvas, { type })`, `sd-plot`, `sd-heatmap`, `sd-uptime`, `sd-meter`, `sd-timeline` (`--from`/`--to` ranges over one axis), `sd-schedule` (hour roster, `data-status` blocks, mono/spectrum), `sd-flow` (pipeline of stages and jobs on a dot grid, `data-status`, mono/spectrum), `sd-machine` (a live state machine from one JSON spec: `mountMachine(figure, spec)` draws stations, wires and tokens that glide, wait, fold (`queue: "latest"`) and land; kinds `box`, `press`, `scan`, `checks`, `line`, `source`, `sink`, more with `defineKind()`; `judge: true` colors a line's dots; `machine.set()` tunes a node live, `machine.load()` swaps the machine; `driven: true` starts nothing by itself, so live events drive it through `machine.emit()`, `start()`, `finish()` and `land()` by key, and `status()` retones a token, `fold()` merges one into another, `clear()` starts over; `set()` also takes `tone`, `frozen`, `label`, `meta`, `items` (checks chips; a finish outcome's `items` sets them by name) and `value` (a sink's tag; `emit` from a sink fans out down its wires); a `link` on a node or `start()` token fires an `open` event on click, and a `predict` event (with `via` and `eta`) when the pointer heads for it; mono/spectrum), `sd-machine-chain` (dashed steps joined by arrows, `data-status` once they run), `sd-checklist` (named checks with a result and progress, the flow's `data-status`), `sd-weighted` (segments sized by `--weight` toward a goal) |
| ASCII art | `mountAscii(el, piece)` from `signal-design/ascii` draws an `ascii-magic-art` piece as greys in `sd-ascii`; still until `aria-busy="true"` (`pnpm add ascii-magic-art`); `data-tone` colors the brightest level |
| Art, mascots and scenes | `sd-art` + `data-sd-art` (15 tech pieces: router, switch, server, database, chip, signal, wifi, mast, battery, globe, packet, terminal, laptop, shield, gear; 16 nature pieces: pine, oak, sprout, mountain, sun, moon, cloud, birds, rock, grass, flower, mushroom, acorn, leaf, waves, signpost; `defineArt()` adds more; React `<Art name tone>`, or `artRects()` for another framework); `sd-mascot` + `data-sd-mascot` (iris, eagle, squirrel, elephant) with `data-mood` (idle, calm, happy, curious, focused, sleepy, alert, offline), `data-tone` on its status light, `aria-busy` to work; `sd-art-scene` (`--cols`, `--rows`) with children at `--x`/`--y` cells and an `sd-art-horizon`; `data-sd-ornaments-style="circuit"` for tech corners |
| Stream overlays (OBS) | `sd-scene` (1920×1080 units in `--sd-u`; `data-full`, `data-clear`) with `sd-scene-copy`, `sd-scene-bar`, `sd-scene-label`, `sd-cam`, `sd-scene-goal`, `sd-credits`, `sd-stream-alert`; `mountStream(scene).alert({ kind, name })` |
| Empty | `sd-empty` (gets a center ornament automatically) |
| Pointer prediction | `data-sd-predict` (a target: `sd:predict` with `via` `path`, `hover`, `touch` or `focus` and an `eta` in ms when the mouse slows toward it or rests on it, once per approach; `data-sd-predicted` on the current one, no style; `sd-rail-tile`, `sd-thread-chip`, `button.sd-shot` and `[data-sd-open]` are targets without it; `data-sd-predict="off"` on a target or an ancestor opts out), `data-sd-prefetch` on a link (`<link rel="prefetch">` for the href or the value, same origin, not under Save-Data), `data-sd-prerender` (a speculation-rules prerender in Chromium, a prefetch elsewhere), `predict(el, fn)` (returns a disposer), `prefetch(url)`, `prerender(url)`, `initPredict()` on pages that skip `init()` |
| Ornaments | `data-sd-ornaments="<placement> <style>"`: dust by default; a style word draws art instead: `contours` (fiction), `lattice` (research), `waveform` (blogs, notes), `dashed` (empty, planned), `book` (the hero), `stack` (manuscripts). Placements `tl tr bl br top bottom center`, `data-sd-ornaments-size`, `data-sd-ornaments-seed`. Faint, behind content |
| React app | `signal-design/react`: `Button`, `Field` + `Input`, `Dialog`, `Menu`, `Tabs`, `ToastProvider`, `Table`, `AppShell` with `Rail`, `Sidebar` and `ShellMain`; editor parts `Toolbar`, `ToolbarButton`, `Manuscript`, `StatusSegment`, `Mark`, `Spoiler`, `ContentWarning`, `HoverCard`, `Tree`, `Combobox`, `CommandPalette`, `RadioGroup`, `SegmentedControl`, `MenuItemCheckbox`; props are the state (`open`/`onOpenChange`, `value`/`onValueChange`, `pressed`/`onPressedChange`); also `Icon`, `Art` (a pixel piece), `GutterBlock` (a margin marker for a block), `HoverCardHost` (a hover card for a trigger React does not render), `ResizablePanel`, `WeightedBar`, `Tree` row `actions` (keys, not buttons inside the treeitem), `Sheet side="bottom"` |
